Noah: Quick flag - nightly preview vs test invoices mismatch after price-table rollout. seeing ~1.4% revenue upside in previews.
Priya: Is this for the A/B experiment or global rollout?
Noah: A/B experiment. cohort-C (variant) previews show higher unit rates for embedding-heavy customers.
Selene: Any clues? could be a version skew between pricing service and invoice generator.
Noah: Yep. pricing-service is on v3.7.1, invoice-svc running v3.6.8 in staging for previews. production invoices use v3.6.8 today.
Marco: That's the problem - v3.7 introduced a minor rounding change for per-chunk billing (int div -> decimal). previews are using new logic, final invoices still old logic.
Ethan: Product note: we rely on previews to decide whether cohort C goes live tomorrow. This skew would bias us to think revenue increases.
Priya: Action: pause cohort promotions (no new enrolls) and freeze preview emails. I'll disable job previews-nightly-03.
Selene: I'll coordinate a hotfix: either backport rounding logic or regenerate previews with v3.6.8 pricing logic. which is faster?
Marco: Backport takes ~2 hours including tests; regenerating previews with v3.6.8 is quicker if we can run a replay job.
Noah: Let's regen previews with v3.6.8 to get an apples-to-apples baseline. schedule replay job: `jobs/replay_pricing --since 2024-03-25 --tables price_table_v3.6.8`
billing-bot: Incident created: FIN-2295 - "pricing version skew: preview/invoice mismatch" assigned to Selene (P2). https://redwood.example/incidents/FIN-2295
Priya: Also check grandfathering rules: some legacy customers got promo=LEGACY_CREDIT flag applied in v3.7 which changes nett rates. ensure replay preserves legacy flags.
Selene: Confirmed. I'll include legacy flag snapshot in replay and output per-account diff csv.
Marco: If replay diff > 0.5% total rev, we hold canary. set threshold in ticket.
Ethan: Product ok with hold threshold 0.5%. finance preferred no surprises on invoices.
Noah: Running replay now. ETA 28m. command: `scripts/replay_previews --engine v3.6.8 --cohorts C,A,B --since 2024-03-24`
Priya: I'll prep a short CS note in case any preview links were shared: "Previews were generated with a new pricing engine; we are regenerating to ensure accuracy. No invoices have been issued." cc legal.
Selene: Replay finished. initial diff: projected delta 0.12% (within threshold). attached per-account delta uploaded to FIN-2295.
Noah: Great. Priya revert the enrollment freeze and re-enable previews.
Priya: Enrollment job re-enabled and preview emails unpaused.
billing-bot: FIN-2295 marked resolved by Selene.
Ethan: Thanks team. let's add a CI check to detect pricing-engine version drift between services before nightly previews run.
Marco: Agreed. I'll open a ticket for automating version consistency checks.
